Night bot: this run is on `_staging`, so it is yours, and it comes first (`priority:high`, and you take it before every other queued item): production promotes itself only from a daily run on `_staging` that passes every job, so it waits on this fix, and `_staging` holds still until this issue closes (scripts/promote-staging.sh, the freeze). Fix every failed job here, in the one pull request on `main` that closes this: when it closes, `_staging` takes main's first green commit after the close and the super run starts on it at once, and a run still red opens a new issue. Before you start, look for an open pull request or issue already fixing one of these jobs, and build on it instead of fixing the same test twice. Root-cause each failed job from its log and fix it in a pull request: a flake is not a root cause, so make a flaky test robust instead of re-running it, and never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. Reproduce it with the job's own command (CLAUDE.md, Commands; one fuzz seed is `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1`, with `--handicap` for the handicapped wave and `--duos` for the Duos wave; a daily test is `cargo test -p <crate> <name> -- --ignored`). A pull request's CI runs only the e2e smoke specs and leaves the tests marked `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` out, so say in the pull request which job here the fix makes pass and how you checked it. You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/super.yml`._

- Run on `_staging` 72dc211 (the #3811 fix). Main HEAD 8c533c6 = 72dc211 + #3884 (Armor event) + #3918 (history test).

1. plain 1596 + 2217 (shard 1), I2 extra attack. Overdrive Dome (S+ #63; also S+ #62 Projector) wakes at a turn start
   inside one autopilot action; units attack twice under its aura Windfury and are gone by the action's end. Monitor
   (crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs) sees Windfury only on states between actions. End state has the Dome awake.
   FIX: `fn aura_gives_windfury(state)` over `crate::layers::aura_entries` (make it pub(crate)) checking
   `entry.mod_.keywords` has Windfury; new monitor field `aura_windfury: bool` set in `before`; in `after`'s I2
   per_turn, a declarer not on the field at the action's end gets WINDFURY_ATTACKS when
   `self.aura_windfury || aura_gives_windfury(state)`. No ruling (cite R636, R3556008).
   Tests: crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs new mod after i2_a_windfury_unit_that_enters_inside_one_action.
2. handicap 2788 (shard 2) I16: S+ #6.2 Stinky Cheese evolved in GY (R3566004), TG #55 Reminisce Discovers it to hand;
   zones::move_to_zone never resets GY/exile -> hand/library, so `evolved` rides into the hand (I16 + existing test
   i16_a_hand_card_holding_giga_..._evolved say never). FIX R3920000: in move_to_zone, from GY|Exile to Hand|Library
   with evolved==Some(true) (keep_state not set) -> reset_instance. Spec: spec/03-zones.md line 45 (Evolved bullet).
   Test r3920000_... in crates/engine/tests/rules/invariants.rs after r3566004_i16_... (helpers playing/new_instance/i16).
3. handicap 4517 (shard 2) growth 2106 > 2000: core-033 Unstable Clone Machine + S+ #89 Animosity (only card with
   cast_from_deck_when, R3558007) + M #3 Jlockwork; each action deck-casts up to DECK_CAST_ACTION_CAP=60 Animosities,
   each a play (R70) -> Clone Machine shuffles 3 copies each -> ~240 instances/action.
   FIX R3920001: a deck cast is no play, as a cast on draw (R2179002, HS Casts When Drawn). Implement by
   `PlayRun.from_deck: Option<bool>` (serde default/skip), `CastOptions.from_deck`, set in
   play_steps::cast_through_pipeline next to `run.drawn_as = drawn_as;`, `cast_on_draw(run)` returns
   `run.drawn_as.is_some() || run.from_deck == Some(true)` (drives the counts, gifted program, record_play and the
   events' `on_draw: Some(true)`, which triggers::dispatch_event_at and query::cast_on_draw_event pass by);
   deck_cast::run_deck_cast passes `CastOptions { from_deck: Some(true), ..Default::default() }`.
   release_draw keys on drawn_as only (unchanged). Docs: events.rs on_draw (TS regen!), spec/06-keywords.md:106.
   Tests: hand_deck_fuse.rs r3920001 (no play counted, on_draw on events), c089_animosity.rs r3920001 with core-033.
   Patch fragment needed (`patches ... --rule --plays` from classify).

## Component shard 1 (6 fail)
- card-faces B15 at 270: S+ #4 Profe Yates and S+ #121 Toxopid are "clamp" in crates/shared/data/short-forms.json but
  run 11 lines at PREVIEW_TEXT_LIMIT (45x10) -> clamp at 270 where nothing may. FIX: forms 004 -> 1 (Lines(1): 6 lines
  at 28 cpl), 121 -> 2 (4 lines). Per-PR guard in apps/web/src/cards/textLimit.test.ts: every "clamp" face's printed
  text fits PREVIEW_TEXT_LIMIT. Doc in crates/shared/src/face/short.rs header.
- keyword-visuals: wasm face "missing field `n`": Burn/Toxic/Tipsy (added #3786) need n; spec's keywordOf gives n

- component shard 3 (running /tmp/comp3.log), e2e shards 2,5,6,8 (need server+client preview), daily tests
  (compiled via cargo test --no-run, /tmp/daily-build.log), suspect fuzz.rs top-up test playing 2465x2 extra seeds.
